summary: Full backend+frontend testing of LPK Hakusa Edu Japan Finance Journal. 23/23 backend pytest tests pass (auth, RBAC, transactions, students, income summary, options, dashboard, export, duplicate protection, jobs). Frontend verified: login, dashboard with all 5 testid metrics populated with real data, navigation to Jurnal/Siswa/Pemasukan/Job Open/Pengaturan, add-jurnal-btn opens tx-dialog correctly, Pengaturan has Kategori & Pengguna tabs, mobile 390px shows mobile-menu-btn and sidebar sheet. No critical issues found.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: CORS_ORIGINS='*' combined with allow_credentials=True is invalid per CORS spec. Browsers will reject credentialed requests. Should be an explicit origin list for production. (Currently harmless because frontend uses Bearer token in Authorization header, not cookies, so no credentials sent.)

routes_finance.py list_transactions: pagination not implemented server-side (returns full array; frontend paginates). For TG/JATIM scale (~1500 tx) it's fine, but will degrade. Also saldo_akhir is pre-filter; after filtering, display 'saldo_akhir' may mislead users (returns full-ledger terminal balance).

routes_finance.py _check_duplicate: duplicate detection keyed only by (student_id, tanggal, masuk, keluar). Does not cover non-student duplicates and ignores keterangan/kategori. Acceptable per spec but should be documented.
core.py get_current_user: reads cookie 'access_token' but login endpoint never sets it — only returns Bearer. Dead code path; harmless but misleading.
No rate limiting on /api/auth/change-password or /api/users POST (admin-only, lower risk).
routes_auth.py login: lockout counter resets to 0 when 5 is reached — after 15 min expiry, user gets another 5 attempts, which is intended but worth documenting.
seed_data_creation: All TEST_ prefixed records (student, 3 transactions, option, staff user, job) auto-cleaned via session-scope fixture teardown. No modification of real imported JATIM/TG data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: DB has 58 imported TG students (all biaya=0 by design, so total_kekurangan=0 and dashboard shows a yellow banner). Admin login works with Bearer token stored in localStorage key hk_token. All critical testids present and working: total-masuk-display, total-keluar-display, total-saldo-display, profit-jm-display, total-kekurangan-display, add-jurnal-btn, tx-dialog, tx-duplicate-warning, tx-force-save-btn, student-add-payment-btn, mobile-menu-btn, login-email-input, login-password-input, login-submit-btn. Backend regression test file at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py — run with: pytest /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py -v
